purpose: Teach: 糞/ガール/うーむ/じゃぁ/仔/菊/帖/フン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、忙しさに「糞、時間がない」とつぶやいてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, this customer was muttering "damn, no time" between orders.
lines.style: Amused, conspiratorial half-smile in the voice. Soft, sharing an inside moment. Light and knowing — not mocking the customer, observing their harried state with gentle humor.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様のガールフレンドのお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: This customer was telling Aoi about their grandchild's girlfriend.
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Slight pause before speaking, like she's picturing the moment. Gentle curiosity — the way you remember someone's personal story because it mattered to them.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メニューを見て「うーむ、迷うね」と仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer looked at the menu and said, "Hmm, it's hard to choose."
lines.style: Thoughtful, mirroring the customer's gentle indecision. Measured pace, soft — like watching someone take their time with a small decision. No rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「じゃぁ、本日のおすすめで」って仰って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they ended up saying, "Alright, I'll go with today's special."
lines.style: Light resolution in the voice. Warm acceptance — the ease of someone trusting a recommendation. Slight upward lift at the end, like relief and ease settling in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご自宅の仔犬の写真を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They showed Aoi a photo of their new puppy at home.
lines.style: Soft brightness entering the tone. Genuine delight — the kind of warmth that comes from witnessing someone share something they love. Gentle pace, like savoring the moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、菊の花展のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: This customer was telling her about the chrysanthemum flower exhibition.
lines.style: Engaged, attentive reflection. Patient pacing — the rhythm of someone listening and holding details that matter to another person. Quiet respect in every word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、京都の旅館の十帖部屋のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were talking about staying in a ten-tatami room at a ryokan in Kyoto.
lines.style: Slightly wistful, imaginative tone. Gentle wonder — she's picturing their memory as they tell it. Unhurried delivery, like traveling with them through the story.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、自分を笑いながら「フン、まだ若いさ」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they laughed at themselves, saying, "Ha, I'm still young enough for that."
lines.style: Warm amusement with a hint of tender irony. The laughter in the voice is genuine — she's smiling at their self-deprecation. Close, intimate delivery, like sharing a joke between friends.
